I've looked over the finished app, and it's what we worked out together. It opens to the same welcoming empty state I approved, with the collection, Read later, and Archive all set up and the clear "save your first bookmark" starting point. Everything we settled across those flows is here — saving a link with the details filled in and editable, recognizable cards, tags and filtering, notes, the forgiving case-insensitive search, read-later, duplicate prevention, archive and restore, the graceful empty and error states, and holding onto my saved details — and you've confirmed it all passed your checks, including keeping my data across restarts.

This is the app I wanted: my messy pile of bare links turned into something I can save quickly, organize, and actually find again. I accept it, and I'm happy to complete this cycle.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
